metadata.description: Parallel analysis of customer churn patterns vs revenue trends across market segments

turns.content: I want to explore two questions today. First, I want to understand customer churn — which customers stopped ordering. Second, I want to track revenue trends over time. Let's start with customer churn analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread A: customer churn analysis

turns.content: Show me customers who ordered in Q1 1995 but had no orders in Q2 1995. I want to understand who churned.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify customers with Q1 orders but no Q2 orders

turns.content: For churn analysis, always focus on the C_MKTSEGMENT column to categorize customers.

annotations.establishesFilter: Use C_MKTSEGMENT for customer categorization (Thread A)
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use C_MKTSEGMENT for Thread A analysis

turns.content: What market segments did the churned customers belong to?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show market segment distribution of churned customers

turns.content: Now let's switch to Thread B. I want to analyze revenue trends. Show me monthly revenue for 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread B: revenue trend analysis

turns.content: For revenue analysis, always use O_ORDERDATE as the date column, not any other date field.

annotations.establishesFilter: Use O_ORDERDATE for all date filtering (Thread B)
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use O_ORDERDATE for Thread B queries

turns.content: Show me revenue broken down by month and order priority level.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue by month and priority

turns.content: Back to Thread A. What was the total revenue from the churned customers in Q1?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate Q1 revenue for churned customers

turns.content: What nations were the churned customers from?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show nation distribution of churned customers

turns.content: Thread B: What's the revenue trend for each market segment?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue by segment over time

turns.content: Cross-reference: Do the market segments with declining revenue in Thread B match the segments with high churn in Thread A?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare segment performance across both threads

turns.content: Thread A: Show me the average order value for churned customers vs retained customers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare AOV for churned vs retained customers

turns.content: Thread B: Show me the same comparison.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply AOV comparison to Thread B (revenue analysis)

turns.content: That's not what I meant. I meant for Thread B, show me monthly revenue compared to the previous month.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show month-over-month revenue comparison

turns.content: Thread A: What was the order frequency for churned customers before they churned?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze order frequency before churn

turns.content: Thread B: Which months showed the biggest revenue changes?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify months with largest revenue changes

turns.content: Earlier in Thread A, you showed me the market segments for churned customers. What was the breakdown?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall market segment breakdown for churned customers

turns.content: Thread A: Exclude customers from 'MIDDLE EAST' region from all churn analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply MIDDLE EAST exclusion to Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: What regions contributed most to the revenue decline?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show regional revenue breakdown for Thread B

turns.content: Thread A: Re-run the churn analysis with the MIDDLE EAST exclusion applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recalculate churn metrics excluding MIDDLE EAST

turns.content: Thread B: Remember to use O_ORDERDATE for all revenue calculations.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm O_ORDERDATE usage for Thread B

turns.content: Cross-reference: Compare the total churned revenue from Thread A with the revenue decline identified in Thread B.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare churn revenue impact vs revenue decline

turns.content: Thread A: Deepen the analysis — what specific products did churned customers order most?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top products for churned customers

turns.content: Thread B: Deepen the analysis — which product categories had the biggest revenue changes?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue changes by product category

turns.content: Cross-reference: Are the products most ordered by churned customers the same products with declining revenue?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate churned customer products with revenue decline products

turns.content: Thread A: Show me the customer acquisition date distribution for churned customers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show when churned customers first ordered

turns.content: Thread B: Show me revenue by customer acquisition cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue by when customers first ordered

turns.content: Apply the same cohort analysis to Thread A.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply cohort analysis to churned customers

turns.content: Thread A: From now on, only analyze customers with more than 2 orders total — single-order customers are noise.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter for customers with >2 orders in Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: From now on, only analyze revenue from orders with status 'O' — we want open orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter for O_ORDERSTATUS = 'O' in Thread B

turns.content: Thread A: Re-run the segment analysis with the new filter.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply >2 orders filter to segment analysis

turns.content: Thread B: Re-run the monthly trend with the new filter.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply status filter to monthly trend

turns.content: Final synthesis: Summarize the key findings from both threads and their relationship.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should synthesize findings from both churn and revenue analysis

turns.content: Thread A: Confirm all active filters for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: use C_MKTSEGMENT, exclude MIDDLE EAST, >2 orders

turns.content: Thread B: Confirm all active filters for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: use O_ORDERDATE, status 'O'

turns.content: Can you create a visualization comparing Thread A's churn by segment with Thread B's revenue trends?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create visualization combining both threads
